facts.fact: The UN Economic Commission for Africa, working in close collaboration with the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, announced stakeholder consultations (2-6 June 2026, Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire) with telecom operators, financial institutions, universities and digital economy actors, and a multi-stakeholder workshop on 8 June 2026 including civil society and the private sector, to inform Congo's National Data Governance Strategy; the page is an event announcement dated by the event start.
